rule_outs: Dwelling 5 m from the best section
summary: Side-street kerb with houses 5-12m away, steep and narrow.

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 5m, 6m and 9m from the kerb; thick trees but exposed to the houses.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow side street, the first 8m is the junction mouth; little room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street beside a collector road junction.
drivers.convention: One car parked on this side in 2022; 2P resident-permit sign applies.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the kerb from the east and south.

best_section.where: West kerb of the side street at its junction with Carmody Road
